integrity: The primary open full text was inspected at the UMg transformation, survival function, MRL definition, the transformed unbounded integral, the local power-series substitution, and Eq. (3.5). The parent Mgamma paper's MRL section was also inspected. The divergent-term proof is analytic, and a standalone checker was replayed from the packaged path against direct quadrature.
scientific_limitations: The finding corrects the UMg mean-residual-life representation and does not reassess all other properties or estimators in the article.
The exact corrected formula uses the standard exponential integral E1.
A very recent unindexed author correction could exist outside the records examined.
title: The UMg mean-residual-life series diverges for every parameter
